_comment: Named groups of astra tools fit for a KIND of project. Non-exclusive: installing one adds its tools and never removes another's, and two templates may overlap freely — swift-ios and legal-pdf both pull the writing tools, and installing one after the other must leave both intact. A template may also list other TEMPLATES as members ('templates'), resolved transitively; the composed leaves follow Jonathan's dictated structure (SPEC.md, 2026-08-31): Xcode, Swift and Mac as building blocks, higher-level templates as compositions of them.

xcode.description: Drive Xcode through the ONE combined aggregator: Apple's bridge + Drew's server + a narrow XcodeBuildMCP slice (build_run_sim, test_sim, coverage, session defaults — the headless capabilities nothing else has) behind a single approved HTTP endpoint with a measured sieve/map. No direct spawns: mcp-xcode, mcp-xcode-mcp-server and mcp-XcodeBuildMCP remain as standalone tools but no template installs them (XcodeBuildMCP folded into the aggregator 2026-09-01).

swift.description: Swift code quality: the ponytail decision ladder, periphery for dead code, dedup-scan for duplicate code. (Drew's prompt-and-skill material lives in agents-and-prompts and has no installer yet.)

mac.description: Run and drive Mac applications — windows, clicks, keys, screen capture, the accessibility tree.

mac-swift.description: Mac application development: simply the Xcode, Swift and Mac templates as members, because that is what Mac app work actually requires.

swift-ios.description: iOS/Swift app work — the Maharam repos. The Xcode, Swift and Mac templates plus simulator UI driving: the axe CLI and the ios-ui-driving skill (identifiers mandatory, AX-tree targeting, probes ad-hoc, XCUITest-by-identifier promoted for flows a feature iterates on) alongside the ios-simulator MCP. (Keeps its historical name: repos' manifests already record it. mobile-mcp removed 2026-09-01 — arrived undecided in kicker's 2026-07-07 bundle, broken on first real use, and idb covers the job.)

legal-pdf.description: Legal repos — speedway, hoa, grandparentLegal. PDF to searchable text sidecars, OCR for scans, metadata provenance, plus the prose checker. NOTE: grandparentLegal wants `git config jsutils.metadataPolicy all` for every-PDF provenance; the default 'pattern' only does meeting-named files.

kicker-dev.description: Working on kicker itself — its own daemon surface plus the mac and Xcode tooling. Left flat on purpose: composing it with the new xcode template would silently grow what kicker repos install.

writing.description: Prose discipline — the ASD-STE100 standard plus the mechanical checker. Wanted by anything a human reads: the legal repos, the HOA site, client email drafts.
